_note: User-maintained calendar of SCHEDULED data releases the pipeline must never report as fact before they occur. Add upcoming entries from official sources (BLS for CPI/PPI/employment, the Fed for FOMC). Each release needs an ISO-8601 datetime WITH a timezone offset and one or more lowercase keywords used to match figure-bearing facts. Entries whose datetime is in the past are harmless (ignored automatically), so stale entries never need pruning — but a MISSING upcoming entry silently drops protection for that release, so keep the near-term ones current. See freshness.py and orchestrator.py (init writes run_context.txt; validate_research enforces the pre-release gate).
